name: SketchBoost main benchmark
public_scores: Exact per-dataset means and standard deviations are catalogued locally.
assessment: Best direct published comparison currently identified because every task has multiple outputs and the public code exposes exact metric definitions.

name: Mulan multi-target and multilabel datasets
public_scores: Selected peer-reviewed and archived scores are catalogued locally; protocols vary by publication.
assessment: Dated but still useful for continuity and shared-output smoke tests. Do not make it the sole evidence base.

name: UCO comprehensive multilabel classifier comparison
current_mbtr_coverage: not yet implemented; its official ten train/generalization partitions require a separate adapter
public_scores: Detailed per-dataset results for 62 methods and 197 configurations are downloadable. They are not comparable to KDIS's separate five-fold archives.
assessment: Best modern multilabel method comparison found. Pin its official mldata.zip and ten supplied partitions before importing scores.

name: KDIS iterative-stratified five-fold archives
public_scores: No matching public method table is currently catalogued; use these fixed archives for reproducible standard-versus-linear MBTR comparisons.
assessment: Useful fixed multilabel folds, but distinct from both the historical Mulan holdout and the UCO 2024 ten-partition benchmark.

name: ICML 2025 multi-output conformal regression corpus
current_mbtr_coverage: all dense point-prediction datasets after preparation
public_scores: Published scores evaluate conformal regions rather than point prediction; fresh point baselines on persisted seeded splits are required.
assessment: Best modern public regression-corpus expansion found. Reproduce and persist its seeded splits; it modernizes the data but does not supply directly comparable RMSE baselines.

name: Comprehensive multilabel classification study
public_scores: Raw results cover 26 methods and 20 predictive and efficiency measures.
assessment: Rich public scores and timings but mostly classic datasets. Reproduce PCut only for literature comparison and add validation-selected thresholds.

name: OpenML-CC18
current_mbtr_coverage: 35 binary tasks; 37 multiclass tasks require a future categorical multiclass objective
public_scores: OpenML exposes reusable public runs but not one canonical method table with a single tuning budget.
assessment: Useful standardized scalar classification breadth with fixed one-repeat stratified 10-fold splits. It contains no regression or multilabel tasks and cannot test shared-output benefit.

name: OpenML-CTR23
public_scores: Exact per-dataset RMSE is public for XGBoost, random forest, GAM, ridge, and a regression tree.
assessment: Strong scalar regression reference. Pin task-provided split indices: the live tasks disagree with paper prose about holdouts for large datasets.

name: OpenML AutoML Benchmark classification
public_scores: Controlled published results compare nine AutoML frameworks.
assessment: Publication-backed but substantially heavier than CC18; use only after the small scalar studies are stable.

name: OpenML AutoML Benchmark regression
public_scores: Controlled published results compare nine AutoML frameworks.
assessment: Publication-backed but includes datasets up to ten million rows; not an initial MBTR study or CI target.

name: TALENT-tiny
public_scores: Official mean scores are public; repository tables also report standard deviations over 15 seeds.
assessment: Preferred first modern breadth study. Pin a commit and dataset archive hash because there are no tagged releases and the archive is mutable.

name: TALENT basic benchmark
public_scores: Official per-dataset classification and regression tables are public for many classical and neural baselines.
assessment: Expand here only after TALENT-tiny. All targets are scalar; shared and independent MBTR are identical on these tasks.
